content.text: Lots of 5-year-olds still co-sleep, and it's very fixable at Milo's age. Start with a "stay till drowsy" step. Do your normal bedtime routine in his own bed and sit beside it, then tell him ahead of time that you'll leave once he's sleepy. Tonight, stay put and keep quiet. After a few nights, move your chair a bit farther from the bed each time.
